title: Epoll thundering herd lock contention on multi-core accept socket wakeups
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0008: Epoll thundering herd lock contention on multi-core accept socket wakeups
Repository: `crossbeam-rs/crossbeam`
Category: `Concurrency & Lockless Race Conditions`
Target File: `net/socket/epoll_server.c`

#### Problem Description
EPOLLEXCLUSIVE flag ignored during socket reuseport reallocation, cascading spurious EWOULDBLOCK wakeups.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Enforce EPOLLEXCLUSIVE registration and implement lock-free socket queue distribution.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0008.py -q`
expected_invariant: Enforce EPOLLEXCLUSIVE registration and implement lock-free socket queue distribution.
